g.text: Scene 2009 · nominal noisy · χ real; same truth-volume color range for every method
Red/yellow = under/over the saved truth color range; gray = nonfinite or missing. Feasibility is given by the saved status. Headers report full-volume statistics; axes are mesh coordinates.
